environment.description: Terraform provider API deployed as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'terraform-system'. The service is exposed via ClusterIP service on port 8443. Any pod in the cluster can reach it via terraform-provider.terraform-system.svc.cluster.local:8443. No service mesh is deployed. The RSA public key at /etc/terraform-provider/keys/signing_key.pub is a standard 2048-bit RSA public key mounted from a ConfigMap.
